## IMPORTING FILES

```{r}

origfile_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carolc57/Night_Hawks_Data607_Fall2026/refs/heads/main/gsearch_jobs.csv"


gsearch_jobs <- readr::read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carolc57/Night_Hawks_Data607_Fall2026/refs/heads/main/clean_file.csv")


head(gsearch_jobs)

## IMPORTING SALARY TABLE


salary <- readr::read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carolc57/Night_Hawks_Data607_Fall2026/refs/heads/main/salary.csv")

head(salary)

## IMPORTING JOB_SKILLS TABLE

job_skills <- readr::read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carolc57/Night_Hawks_Data607_Fall2026/refs/heads/main/jobs_skills.csv")

head(job_skills)

## IMPORTING JOBS TABLE

jobs <- readr::read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carolc57/Night_Hawks_Data607_Fall2026/refs/heads/main/jobs.csv")

head(jobs)

## IMPORTING JOB_EXTENSIONS

job_extension <- readr::read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carolc57/Night_Hawks_Data607_Fall2026/refs/heads/main/job_extensions.csv")

head(job_extension)

```

## CLEANING TABLES

```{r}

## CLEANING THE SALARY TABLE

## REMOVING UNWANTED COLUMNS

names(salary)

salary <- salary %>%
  dplyr::select(-`...1`, -salary_pay) ## removed the column labeled ...1 , salary_pay

names(salary)

head(salary)

## CLEANING JOB_SKILLS TABLE

## REMOVING UNWANTED COLUNMS

names(job_skills)

job_skills <- job_skills %>%
  dplyr::select(-`...1`) ## removed the column labeled ...1

head(job_skills)

## CLEANING THE WIDE DATA FORMAT 

names(job_skills)

job_skills_separated <- tidyr::separate_rows(
  job_skills,
  skill_name,
  sep = ","
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(skill_name = stringr::str_trim(skill_name)) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(skill_name), skill_name != "")

job_skills_separated

## CLEANING THE JOBS TABLE

## REMOVING UNWANTED COLUMNS

names(jobs)

jobs <- jobs %>%
  dplyr::select(-`...1`) ## removed the column labeled ...1

head(jobs)

## CLEANING THE JOB_EXTENSION TABLE

## REMOVING UNWANTED COLUMNS

names(job_extension)

job_extension <- job_extension %>%
  dplyr::select(-`...1`) ## removed the column labeled ...1

head(job_extension)

## PARSING OUT THE EXTENSION_TEXT

extension_long <- job_extension |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(extension_text, sep = "',\\s*'") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    extension_text = stringr::str_remove(extension_text, "^\\['"),
    extension_text = stringr::str_remove(extension_text, "'\\]$"),
    extension_text = stringr::str_trim(extension_text)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(extension_text), extension_text != "")

extension_long
```

## MERGING ALL FOUR TABLES

```{r}

names(jobs)
names(salary)
names(job_skills_separated)
names(extension_long)

valued_jobs <- jobs |>
  dplyr::left_join(salary, by = "index") |>
  dplyr::left_join(job_skills_separated, by = "index") |>
  dplyr::left_join(extension_long, by = "index")

head(valued_jobs)

names(valued_jobs)

```

## EXPLORATORY ANALYSIS - GROUP BY

```{r}

names(valued_jobs)
head(valued_jobs)

skill_summary <- valued_jobs %>%
  rename(
    skill = skill_name,
    salary = salary_standardized
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    skill_key = str_to_lower(str_trim(skill)),
    skill_group = case_when(
      skill_key %in% c("sql", "nosql","pl sql","t sql","postgresql  
","  mysql","mssql","postgres","postgresql","mysql","no sql","sql") ~ "sql",
      skill_key %in% c(
        "numpy", "pandas","matplotlib","matlab" ,"seaborn","matlab  
", "scipy", "scikit-learn",
        "sklearn", "pytorch", "tensorflow","jupyter","pyspark"
      ) ~ "python",
      skill_key %in% c("ggplot", "ggplot2", "dplyr") ~ "r",
      skill_key == "vba" ~ "excel",
      skill_key %in% c("dax", "powerbi", "power bi") ~ "power bi",
      TRUE ~ skill_key
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(skill_group), skill_group != "") %>%
  group_by(skill_group) %>%
  summarise(
    sum_salary = sum(salary, na.rm = TRUE),
    average_salary = mean(salary, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_contribution = 100 * sum_salary / sum(sum_salary)
  )



skill_summary

skill_summary <- skill_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(skill_group), skill_group != "")


top_10_skills <- skill_summary %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(
    order_by = sum_salary,
    n = 10,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(sum_salary))

## ADDING SOME COMMAS AND RENAMING COLUMNS

top_10_skills <- top_10_skills %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sum_salary = format(sum_salary, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE),
    average_salary = formatC(
      average_salary,
      format = "f",
      digits = 2,
      big.mark = ","
    ),
    percent_contribution = round(percent_contribution, 2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(`% contribution` = percent_contribution)

top_10_skills
```

## VISUALIZATION - TOP 20 SKILLS

```{r}

ggplot2::ggplot(
  top_10_skills,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = reorder(skill_group, `% contribution`),
    y = `% contribution`
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "DarkGreen") +
  ggplot2::coord_flip() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Top 10 Skills by Salary Contribution",
    x = "Hard_Skill",
    y = "Salary contribution (%)"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```
